statement: For a finite genuine weakly reversible list with fixed positive kappa,actual carried product t and x>=t,put z=x-t,V=sum log(z_i!),W_alpha=exp(alpha V),a_t=sum outgoing constants,p_t=a_t(x)_t/q. Genuine s->u resets the actual mark to u and gives DeltaV=log[(x)_t/(x)_s]. The FULL ordinary jump law obeys E exp(alpha DeltaV)<=(mR)^alpha p_t^alpha,0<alpha<1,R=max a/min a. A finite guarded word may designate s!=t only with an acquired uniform (x)_s>=c(x)_t,0<c<=1. Any mismatch stops at its actual output. Selected coefficient>=q0 c p_t,q0=min kappa/max a,so the banked scalar recursion pays all branches. Exact neutral source equality has c1 and zero increment. For acquired maximum designated length h,set L0=1,L_(j+1)=(q0 c)^-1 exp(log(mR)+2L_j),alpha=1/(4L_h),eta=alpha,pstar=(mR)^-1 2^(-1/alpha). These are finite existential constants,not expanded numerical outputs. If the finite candidate library has PROVED complete escaping-face terminal-rarity coverage,its exact least-final-mark-probability selector gives a finite head and E W_out<=(1-eta)W_in outside it. Entire physical occupation/activity costs Cocc=(h+1)(1+1/kappa_min)c^(-alpha h),with actual holding means and every failed branch. For C>=(Cocc+1)/eta,U=CW off-head and0on-head, E[integral(1+q)W dt+U(actual output)]<=U(input)-1. Numerical exponent,head and stationary normalization remain unacquired.
